page.description: ScholarQuest: a benchmark for research-intent-aware academic paper search. Explore system and model configuration results.
page.subtitle: A benchmark for research-intent-aware paper search.
page.table_caption: ScholarQuest results by research intent. Higher recall is better.
page.table_help: Click a name for settings; click a column to sort.
page.metric_text: Recall@k measures gold-paper coverage among the first k results; Recall@All uses the full ranking at termination. Scores are query-level macro means. arXiv versions are merged and duplicate papers retain their earliest rank.
page.system_text: All 1,111 queries: Method (302), Setting (322), Scope (317), and Comparison (170). Agent results are means over three runs. Retrieval and agentic systems use ScholarBase; external services use their own indexes and return at most 300 papers. Original system budgets and stopping rules are retained; this is not a matched-budget comparison. Other systems' repeat counts are not specified in the manuscript.
page.model_text: ScholarQuest-100 contains 25 queries per intent. All configurations share the search harness, with up to 15 rounds and 5 parallel tool calls per round. Failed or incomplete queries and invalid token records are excluded. Valid query sets differ; overall scores are means over each configuration's valid queries. Prompts and inference settings vary, including a dedicated GPT-5.6-Sol keyword-search prompt.
page.tokens_text: Configuration details report mean input + output tokens from the final successful Planner attempt. Selector usage, failed attempts and preflight requests are excluded. Reasoning is counted once within completion tokens. Tokenizers differ; these figures do not measure billing cost.
page.about_text: ScholarQuest evaluates whether paper-search systems can satisfy explicit research constraints, beyond matching a topic. Queries cover four intents: a required method, a research setting, an inclusion or exclusion scope, and a comparative finding.
page.limits_text: The benchmark spans 355 topic labels and 36 arXiv computer-science categories. Gold relevance is grounded in titles, abstracts and metadata; coverage is not guaranteed to be exhaustive. A missing gold match does not by itself establish irrelevance.
page.citation_note: Manuscript citation; update the venue and identifier when available.
page.footer: Results transcribed from the ScholarQuest manuscript.

page.description: ScholarQuest：面向研究意图的学术论文检索基准。查看系统与模型配置的评测结果。
page.subtitle: 面向研究意图的学术论文检索基准。
page.stats: 1,111 条查询 · 4 类研究意图 · 49,162 篇金标准论文
page.table_caption: ScholarQuest 各类研究意图的评测结果，召回率越高越好。
page.table_help: 点击名称查看配置，点击列名排序。
page.metric_text: Recall@k 衡量前 k 条结果对金标准论文的覆盖率；Recall@All 使用搜索终止时的完整排序结果。分数按查询做宏平均。arXiv 不同版本合并为同一论文，重复论文仅保留最早排名。
page.system_text: 使用全部 1,111 条查询：方法 302 条、情境 322 条、范围 317 条、比较 170 条。智能体结果为三次运行的均值。检索基线和智能体使用 ScholarBase；外部搜索服务使用各自索引，最多返回 300 篇论文。各系统保留原有预算和停止规则，因此并非等预算比较。论文未明确其他系统的重复运行次数。
page.model_text: 使用 ScholarQuest-100，每类意图各 25 条查询。所有配置共享搜索框架，每次查询最多 15 轮、每轮最多 5 个并行工具调用。失败、未完成的查询及无效 token 记录均被排除。不同配置的有效查询集合可能不同，总体得分按各配置的有效查询取均值。提示词和推理设置有所差异，其中 GPT-5.6-Sol 使用专门的关键词搜索提示词。
page.tokens_text: 配置详情中的平均 token 数只统计 Planner 最终成功尝试的输入与输出，不含 Selector、失败尝试和预检请求；推理 token 在输出中只计一次。各模型分词器不同，该指标不代表实际账单费用。
page.about_text: ScholarQuest 评测论文搜索系统能否满足明确的研究约束，而不仅是匹配主题。查询覆盖四类意图：要求使用某种方法、限定研究情境、限定纳入或排除范围，以及要求给出特定比较结论。
page.limits_text: 基准覆盖 355 个主题标签和 36 个 arXiv 计算机科学类别。金标准相关性依据论文标题、摘要与元数据判断，无法保证穷尽所有相关论文；未匹配金标准不等于论文一定不相关。
page.citation_note: 当前为手稿引用；正式发表后更新出版信息与标识符。
page.footer: 结果整理自 ScholarQuest 论文手稿。
